def run_length_encode(s):
    if not s:
        return ""

    encoded_string = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        char = s[i]
        count = 0
        j = i
        while j < len(s) and s[j] == char:
            count += 1
            j += 1
        encoded_string.append(char)
        encoded_string.append(str(count))
        i = j
    return "".join(encoded_string)
